name: mailmypdf
description: Create, review, securely process, and mail document workflows through MailMyPDF.

interface.shortDescription: Create, review, and mail PDFs from chat.
interface.longDescription: Use MailMyPDF to turn notices, appeals, disputes, records requests, claims, and other document problems into secure matters, reviewable drafts and packets, hosted checkout, physical mailing, tracking, and proof.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me handle this document with MailMyPDF. Identify the right workflow, ask only for missing facts, create a reviewable response, and do not approve payment or mailing without my explicit confirmation.
